This decision rests on reversal, not merely on the pale color or on the paper being reused.

residual_uncertainties.detail: The opening favors Changer over Change. The heavily cancelled short item between base and e_1 favors en, with de an alternative. The subscript is read as numeral 1.

The first cancelled word favors aussi over ainsi. The cancelled par is kept. The paired variables favor x,y, with f,g alternatives; the second transformed superscript favors 3 over 2. These are visual alternatives, not mathematical completions.
The repeated letter is read xi; the parameter is read mu. The visible expressions are kept in full, including both plus/minus sets and the final i.
The horizontal stroke under rigidifiées is below the letter bodies and intersects only descenders; recorded as underline, not deletion.
The last noun favors groupoïdes over groupes. The main text is read Elle s'immerse ... il y a lieu de regarder l'effet.
Small adjacent-line fragments at fixed crop boundaries are retained as TikZ strokes, without extrapolating clipped words.
